note_title: Dirichlet核并非逼近单位元；Fejer核是一个逼近单位元
summary_en: This note studies the role of the Dirichlet and Fejer kernels in Fourier series on the circle. It shows that the Dirichlet kernel is not an approximate identity because its \(L^1\)-norm grows like \(\log N\), while the Fejer kernel is an approximate identity and yields a basic uniqueness consequence for Fourier coefficients.

problems.statement_en:
Definition of the Dirichlet kernel: 
\[
D_N(x):=\sum_{|n|\leq N}e^{inx}=\frac{\sin\left[\left(N+\frac{1}{2}\right)x\right]}{\sin(x/2)}.
\]

For a \(2\pi\)-periodic function \(f\) on \([ -\pi,\pi ]\), the \(N\)-th partial Fourier sum satisfies
\[
S_N(f)(x)=\sum_{|n|\le N}\widehat f(n)e^{inx}=\frac1{2\pi}\int_{-\pi}^{\pi} f(y)D_N(x-y)\,dy=f*D_N(x).
\]
problems.statement_zh: 对于定义在\([-\pi,\pi]\)上的周期为\(2\pi\)的函数，傅里叶级数的部分和满足 \(S_N(f)=f*D_N\)。
key_techniques: convolution representation of Fourier partial sums

problems.statement_en:
The Dirichlet kernel is not an approximate identity. Although
\[
\frac{1}{2\pi}\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}D_N(x)\,dx=1,
\]
its \(L^1\)-norm is not uniformly bounded; in fact,
\[
\int_0^{\pi}\frac{|\sin((N+\tfrac12)x)|}{x}\,dx=\frac{2}{\pi}\log N+O(1),
\]
so \(\|D_N\|_{L^1}\) grows like \(\log N\).
problems.statement_zh: Dirichlet核并非逼近单位元。虽然 \(\frac{1}{2\pi}\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}D_N(x)\,dx=1\)，但是其绝对值积分不一致有界，并且相关下界积分满足 \(\int_0^{\pi}\frac{|\sin((N+1/2)x)|}{x}dx=\frac{2}{\pi}\log N+O(1)\)。
关键渐近估计：当 \(k>0\) 时，\(\int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{\sin(s)}{k\pi+s}\,ds=\frac{2}{\pi k}+O\left(\frac{1}{k^2}\right)\)。
key_techniques: local asymptotic expansion inside an integral

problems.statement_en:
Definition of the Cesaro means of Fourier partial sums:
\[
\sigma_N(f):=\frac{S_0(f)+\cdots+S_{N-1}(f)}{N}.
\]

Example: let \(a_n:=(-1)^n\). Its partial sums are
\[
S_n:=\begin{cases}1,& n\text{ even},\\0,& n\text{ odd},\end{cases}
\]
so \(S_n\) does not converge. However, its Cesaro means
\[
\sigma_N:=\frac{S_0+\cdots+S_{N-1}}{N}=\frac{\lfloor N/2+1\rfloor}{N}
\]
converge to \(1/2\).
problems.statement_zh: 例子2.1：\(a_n:=(-1)^n\)，其部分和 \(S_n\) 不收敛，但 \(\sigma_N:=\frac{S_0+\cdots+S_{N-1}}{N}=\frac{\lfloor\frac{N}{2}+1\rfloor}{N}\) 的极限为 \(\frac{1}{2}\)。

problems.statement_en:
Define the Fejer kernel by
\[
F_N:=\frac{D_0+\cdots+D_{N-1}}{N}.
\]
Then
\[
F_N(x)=\frac1N\frac{\sin^2(Nx/2)}{\sin^2(x/2)},
\]
and \(F_N\) is an approximate identity in \(L^1([ -\pi,\pi ])\).
problems.statement_zh: 定理2.2：\(F_N(x):=\frac{1}{N}\frac{\sin^2(Nx/2)}{\sin^2(x/2)}\)，并且这是一个 \(L^1([ -\pi,\pi ])\) 上的逼近单位元。

problems.statement_en:
If \(f\in L^1(\mathbb T)\) and its Fourier coefficients satisfy
\[
\widehat f(n)=0,\quad \forall n\in\mathbb Z,
\]
then \(f=0\) at every point where \(f\) is continuous.
problems.statement_zh: 推论2.3：如果函数 \(f\) 是单位圆周 \(\mathbb{T}\) 上的可积函数，并且其傅里叶系数满足 \(\widehat{f}(n)=0,\forall n\in \mathbb{Z}\)，那么在 \(f\) 的任意连续点处都取值为0。
prerequisites: continuity points of \(L^1\) functions on the circle

key_techniques_discussed: convolution representation of Fourier partial sums
period decomposition for oscillatory integral estimates
positivity and tail control for kernel estimates
